Notices for the autumn season

This page gathers what the harbor office has published for boat owners between September and November. Each notice stands on its own, and each is grouped by area.

North pier closure

Posted 2 September 2026 by the harbor office.

The north pier will be closed to boats while the fenders are replaced. Work starts on 14 September and should take three weeks, weather allowing. Moorings on the north side move to the visitor pontoon for that time.

What this means for you

If your boat lives on the north pier, collect a temporary berth letter from the office before the work begins.

Berth letters

Collect between 8:00 and 16:00, Monday to Friday.

Bring your registration number. Letters are free and valid until the pier reopens.

Issued by the berth clerk.

Electricity and water

Shore power stays on at the visitor pontoon. Water points are shut for the whole period.

Questions

Ring the office on the harbor channel, or call in person. We would sooner answer ten questions than lose one dinghy.

Last updated 2 September 2026. Print this notice.

Winter haul-out bookings

Posted 9 September 2026.

Bookings for the crane open on 1 October. Slots are given in the order requests arrive, and boats over eight tonnes need to say so when booking.

Enquiries to the yard manager.

Next tides

High water at 06:42 and 19:05 on the first Saturday of the month. Check the board on the pier for any change.
